title: Queue prose rows align with wide row numbers
findings_note: s363 relay 2026-10-18: prose and sibling-only queue rows use a fixed 5-cell indent (tui.py ~347, 737, 757), one cell left of item rows once the number slot widens past 999 rows; a long "left out:" notice has no cap
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the relay request rules (s363).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s363 made the item-row number slot as wide as the view's row count. Prose and sibling-only rows still indent by a fixed 5 cells, so past 999 rows they sit one cell left of the item rows. The `Q` notice naming dropped marks can run past the screen and is cut mid-id.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py` (prose and sibling row indent from the same number width; cap the notice with "and N more").
- `tests/test_tui.py`; `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Share the number width; cap the notice.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
